title: Folder tree
description: Reveal a project hierarchy while preserving where the selected file lives.
useCase: Reveal a project hierarchy while preserving where the selected file lives.
reducedMotion: Live system preference disables decorative motion; all controls remain usable. Keyboard actions settle immediately.
limitations: Semantic disclosure with native file buttons, not an ARIA tree widget requiring specialized tree keyboard conventions.
look: Off-white rounded card on a warm grey page: a mustard folder icon, hatched file glyphs, thin tree guide lines and a beige selected row.
motion: Pressing the folder expands or collapses its children by animating grid rows between 0fr and 1fr (220 ms ease-out) as the chevron rotates 90° over 180 ms.
adapt: The collapse is `.branch` transitioning `grid-template-rows` between inline `1fr` and `0fr` with `220ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)` over an `overflow: hidden` child; `inert` disables collapsed rows. Replace `files` and the folder label; nest the pattern for deeper trees.
